svg.text: How a prompt becomes a running app and a live agent. Solid boxes run today; dashed boxes are the production design. Details: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
Agent API key or webhook URL
call agents over HTTPS or MCP
/api/mcp/:id · the agent as an MCP server
routing by cost · failover · per-user spend · key pools · prompt caching
credits: spent only in the database
calls /api/cron/schedules every minute; due schedules are claimed once, in each schedule's timezone
one model for documents and queries
The browser never holds a privileged key: signed-in calls use row-level security; public calls use token-checked security-definer functions.
